records.name: Cathedral Basilica of Saints Peter and Paul
records.summary: The mother church of the Catholic Archdiocese of Philadelphia, open to anyone who wants to pray or attend Mass. Its website lists weekend and weekday Mass times and a public phone line.
records.what_you_do: Attend Mass at the Cathedral Basilica or in the Cathedral Chapel, including a Spanish Mass on Sunday. The site does not list other groups or service programs.

schedule.text: Sunday Masses at 8, 9:30 and 11 am (11 am livestreamed), a Spanish Mass at 12:30 pm, and 6:30 pm. Weekday Masses at 7:15 am and 12:05 pm, a Saturday Mass at 12:05 pm, and an anticipated Saturday Mass at 5:15 pm.

locations.label: Cathedral Basilica (mailing address as printed on the site)

first_step.how: Come to any Mass listed on the site. For other questions, call the cathedral at (215) 561-1313.
first_step.basis: Mass times are posted publicly and the site gives a public phone line, but it describes no newcomer program.

records.notes: The lead was 'Young Adults at the Cathedral Basilica'. Its page (cathedralphila.org/events/young-adult-events) returned HTTP 404, and the home page lists no young adult group or dated event, so no young adult group is recorded. This record is the parish the lead named. Status is probably_active because the site is working but shows no dated events; the copyright year is not used as evidence. The 'Keys & Sword Event' link has no details, so it is not recorded.

records.name: Philly Frassati
records.summary: A Catholic young adult group in Philadelphia, named after Pier Giorgio Frassati. It has planned outdoor adventures, gatherings and faith formation for young adults, and it shares member content on Patreon.
records.what_you_do: Join its adventures, gatherings and faith events. The 2024 event called The Summit included Mass, adoration, faith sharing, fellowship and music.

first_step.how: Use the group's Instagram account or its Patreon page to ask about events. No event calendar or sign-up page was found.
first_step.basis: The only public links found are Instagram and Patreon, and the newest dated item is from 2024.

records.notes: No group website was found. The lead's Patreon page is the only own page and shows no dates. The dated item is a Catholic Philly article posted September 5, 2024, which names Philly Frassati as the host of The Summit (held Saturday, August 31; the event line has no year). The newest dated evidence is more than 24 months old, so status is dormant. Frassati is a name many separate groups use; this record is the Philadelphia group named in that article and on Patreon. The one search used did not turn up a website.

records.name: Atonement Lutheran Church
records.summary: A Lutheran congregation at 1542 East Montgomery Avenue in Philadelphia, listed in the synod's congregation directory with a phone number and a serving pastor. The listing shows no website, worship times or events.

first_step.how: Call the church at (267) 888-4099 to ask about worship times and what the congregation offers.

records.notes: The only source is the synod's congregation directory, dated October 1, 2026 (page 1 of the PDF, read as page images). It lists the address, phone and a serving pastor, with no worship times, website or events. Status is unknown because a directory entry is not an event or news item, even though it is dated. The pastor's name is omitted. Verify by phone before relying on this record.

records.name: Czestochowa Young Adults
records.summary: A Catholic community for people in their 20s and 30s, run as a ministry of the American Czestochowa Shrine in Doylestown, Bucks County. It holds monthly faith and social events, but its page does not say where meetings are held.
records.notes: Out of area: the shrine's contact page gives its address as 654 Ferry Road, Doylestown, PA 18901 (Bucks County). The young adult page says members come from the Greater Philadelphia area, but it does not say where events are held, and it shows no dates or current announcements. This verdict is a judgment call; a reviewer may want to revisit it if Greater Philadelphia groups are in scope. The lead's path /young-adult-ministry/ returned 404, so the current page path was used.

blocked.note: Forbidden when fetched. It is a series of Mass and social events, not a standing group, so no record was written.

notes: Input had 15 leads. Records written: 4 (3 publish, 1 out_of_area). Cathedral Basilica: the lead was a young adult page that returned 404, and the site lists no young adult group, so only the parish is recorded. Philly Frassati: no group website was found; the only own page is Patreon, which shows no dates, so the status rests on a Catholic Philly article posted September 5, 2024 (status dormant). Czestochowa Young Adults: the sponsoring American Czestochowa Shrine is at 654 Ferry Road, Doylestown, PA 18901 (Bucks County), and the group does not say where it meets, so the verdict is out_of_area. Atonement Lutheran: no website; the synod directory PDF (dated October 1, 2026) was read as page images and supplies only the address, phone and listing, so status is unknown. Dropped without a record: First Presbyterian Kensington (domain does not resolve, with or without www); Southwestern Presbyterian (connection closed or refused on 5 tries, www and bare host); Society of St. Vincent de Paul (command failed on 4 tries, http and https); St. Michael Lutheran (DNS error, www and bare host); Emanuel Lutheran (DNS error, both forms); Faith Lutheran (the directory website redirects to an unrelated domain, which was not followed); Reformation Lutheran at welcomeplace.org (DNS error, both forms); St. David Lutheran (DNS error, both forms); St. Paul Lutheran Olney (DNS error, both forms). Mount Hope UMC skipped: the only page is an Eastern PA Conference news item dated June 29, 2026 about a rooftop fundraiser; it gives no city, address, website or way to join, so a Philadelphia location and a way in could not be established. Budget: 1 of 1 WebSearch used (for Philly Frassati); 34 WebFetch calls. No rate-limit responses were seen.
